Try the following to fix the issue:
• Ensure that Metro is running
• Ensure that your device/emulator is connected to your machine and has USB debugging enabled - run 'adb devices' to see a list of connected devices
• Ensure Airplane Mode is disabled
• If you're on a physical device connected to the same machine, run 'adb reverse tcp:<PORT> tcp:<PORT>' to forward requests from your device
• If your device is on the same Wi-Fi network, set 'Debug server host & port for device' in 'Dev settings' to your machine's IP address and the port of the local dev server - e.g. 10.0.1.1:<PORT>




Try the following to fix the issue:
• Ensure that the packager server is running
• Ensure that your device/emulator is connected to your machine and has USB debugging enabled - run 'adb devices' to see a list of connected devices
• Ensure Airplane Mode is disabled
• If you're on a physical device connected to the same machine, run 'adb reverse tcp:<PORT> tcp:<PORT>' to forward requests from your device
• If your device is on the same Wi-Fi network, set 'Debug server host & port for device' in 'Dev settings' to your machine's IP address and the port of the local dev server - e.g. 10.0.1.1:<PORT>

// #version 330 core
#ifdef GL_ES
precision lowp float;
#else
#define highp
#define mediump
#define lowp
#endif
#if __VERSION__ >= 300
#define SAMPLER_FNC(TEX, UV) texture(TEX, UV)
in vec2 vTextureCoord;
out vec4 outColor;  // new in opengl3
#define COLOR_OUT outColor
#else
#define SAMPLER_FNC(TEX, UV) texture2D(TEX, UV)
varying vec2 vTextureCoord;
#define COLOR_OUT gl_FragColor
#endif
uniform sampler2D inputTexture;
uniform float filterSharpness;
uniform float widthRatio;
uniform float heightRatio;
#define SATURATE(x) clamp(x, 0.0, 1.0)
#define SHARPEN_SAMPLER_FNC(TEX, UV) SAMPLER_FNC(TEX, UV).rgb
vec3 edgeDetectSharpen(sampler2D tex, vec2 st, vec2 pixel, float strength) {
    // [                                    ]
    // [      c13,   ,  c9,    ,  c14,      ]
    // [         , c1,  c2,  c3,     ,      ]
    // [      c10, c4,  c0,  c5,  c11,      ]
    // [         , c6,  c7,  c8,     ,      ]
    // [      c15,   ,  c12,   ,  c16,      ]
    // [                                    ]
    vec3 c[25];
    c[0] = SHARPEN_SAMPLER_FNC(tex, st + vec2(0.0, 0.0) * pixel);
    c[1] = SHARPEN_SAMPLER_FNC(tex, st + vec2(-1.0, -1.0) * pixel);
    c[2] = SHARPEN_SAMPLER_FNC(tex, st + vec2( 0.0, -1.0) * pixel);
    c[3] = SHARPEN_SAMPLER_FNC(tex, st + vec2( 1.0, -1.0) * pixel);
    c[4] = SHARPEN_SAMPLER_FNC(tex, st + vec2(-1.0, 0.0) * pixel);
    c[5] = SHARPEN_SAMPLER_FNC(tex, st + vec2( 1.0, 0.0) * pixel);
    c[6] = SHARPEN_SAMPLER_FNC(tex, st + vec2(-1.0, 1.0) * pixel);
    c[7] = SHARPEN_SAMPLER_FNC(tex, st + vec2( 0.0, 1.0) * pixel);
    c[8] = SHARPEN_SAMPLER_FNC(tex, st + vec2( 1.0, 1.0) * pixel);
    c[9] = SHARPEN_SAMPLER_FNC(tex, st + vec2(  0.0, -2.0) * pixel);
    c[10] = SHARPEN_SAMPLER_FNC(tex, st + vec2(-2.0,  0.0) * pixel);
    c[11] = SHARPEN_SAMPLER_FNC(tex, st + vec2( 2.0,  0.0) * pixel);
    c[12] = SHARPEN_SAMPLER_FNC(tex, st + vec2( 0.0,  2.0) * pixel);
    c[13] = SHARPEN_SAMPLER_FNC(tex, st + vec2( -2.0, -2.0) * pixel);
    c[14] = SHARPEN_SAMPLER_FNC(tex, st + vec2( -2.0,  2.0) * pixel);
    c[15] = SHARPEN_SAMPLER_FNC(tex, st + vec2(  2.0, -2.0) * pixel);
    c[16] = SHARPEN_SAMPLER_FNC(tex, st + vec2(  2.0,  2.0) * pixel);
    // Blur
    // selectBlur(blur, img, 1, 20);
    vec3 mask = 20.0 * c[0]
               - 2.0 * (c[1]  + c[3] + c[6]  + c[8])
               - 1.0 * (c[2]  + c[4] + c[5]  + c[7] +
                        c[9]  + c[10] + c[11]  + c[12] +
                        c[13]  + c[14] + c[15]  + c[16]);
    mask = step(40.0 / 255.0, abs(mask));
    // edge detect
    //  a b c
    //  d(e)f
    //  g h i
    vec3 edge = 8.0 * c[0] - (c[1]  + c[3] + c[6] + c[8] + c[2]  + c[4] + c[5]  + c[7]);
    vec3 sharpen = c[0] + mask * edge * 0.5 * strength;
    // overshoot control
    float over_ctrl = 0.8;
    vec3 mnRGB = min(min(min(c[4], c[0]), min(c[5], c[2])), c[7]);
    mnRGB += min(mnRGB, min(min(c[1], c[3]), min(c[6], c[8])));
    mnRGB /= 2.0;
    vec3 mxRGB = max(max(max(c[4], c[0]), max(c[5], c[2])), c[7]);
    mxRGB +=  max(mxRGB, max(max(c[1], c[3]), max(c[6], c[8])));
    mxRGB /= 2.0;
    vec3 flag = step(mxRGB, sharpen);
    vec3 flag2 = step(sharpen, mnRGB);
    sharpen = mix(sharpen,  mxRGB + over_ctrl * (sharpen - mxRGB), flag);
    sharpen = mix(sharpen, mnRGB + over_ctrl * (sharpen - mnRGB), flag2);
    return SATURATE(sharpen);
}
void main()
{
    mediump vec3 resColor = SAMPLER_FNC(inputTexture, vTextureCoord).rgb;
    vec3 filterColor = resColor;
    vec2 pixel = vec2(widthRatio, heightRatio);
    filterColor = edgeDetectSharpen(inputTexture, vTextureCoord, pixel, filterSharpness).rgb;
    filterColor = mix(resColor, filterColor, clamp(filterSharpness, 0.0, 1.0));
    COLOR_OUT = vec4(filterColor, 1.0);
}

#extension GL_OES_EGL_image_external : require
precision lowp float;
uniform samplerExternalOES oes_tex;
 varying highp vec2 interp_tc;
 uniform sampler2D lutImageTexture;
 uniform vec4 v4Param;


 vec4 smoothskin(vec4 sourceColor)
  {
      float central;
      float gaussianWeightTotal;
      float sum;
      float sample;
      float distanceFromCentralColor;
      float gaussianWeight;

      float distanceNormalizationFactor = 3.6;

      central = sourceColor.g;
      gaussianWeightTotal = 0.2;
      sum = central * 0.2;
      vec2 blurCoordinates2[8];
      vec2 blurCoordinates[12];

      float smooth = v4Param.x;
      float enhance = v4Param.y;

      float mul_x = 0.00277777;
      float mul_y = 0.0015625;

      blurCoordinates[0] = interp_tc.xy + vec2(0.0 * mul_x,-10.0 * mul_y);
      blurCoordinates[1] = interp_tc.xy + vec2(5.0 * mul_x,-8.0 * mul_y);
      blurCoordinates[2] = interp_tc.xy + vec2(8.0 * mul_x,-5.0 * mul_y);
      blurCoordinates[3] = interp_tc.xy + vec2(10.0 * mul_x,0.0 * mul_y);
      blurCoordinates[4] = interp_tc.xy + vec2(8.0 * mul_x,5.0 * mul_y);
      blurCoordinates[5] = interp_tc.xy + vec2(5.0 * mul_x,8.0 * mul_y);
      blurCoordinates[6] = interp_tc.xy + vec2(0.0 * mul_x,10.0 * mul_y);
      blurCoordinates[7] = interp_tc.xy + vec2(-5.0 * mul_x,8.0 * mul_y);
      blurCoordinates[8] = interp_tc.xy + vec2(-8.0 * mul_x,5.0 * mul_y);
      blurCoordinates[9] = interp_tc.xy + vec2(-10.0 * mul_x,0.0 * mul_y);
      blurCoordinates[10] = interp_tc.xy + vec2(-8.0 * mul_x,-5.0 * mul_y);
      blurCoordinates[11] = interp_tc.xy + vec2(-5.0 * mul_x,-8.0 * mul_y);

      mul_x = 0.00222222;
      mul_y = 0.00125;

      blurCoordinates2[0] = interp_tc.xy + vec2(0.0 * mul_x,-6.0 * mul_y);
      blurCoordinates2[1] = interp_tc.xy + vec2(-4.0 * mul_x,-4.0 * mul_y);
      blurCoordinates2[2] = interp_tc.xy + vec2(-6.0 * mul_x,0.0 * mul_y);
      blurCoordinates2[3] = interp_tc.xy + vec2(-4.0 * mul_x,4.0 * mul_y);
      blurCoordinates2[4] = interp_tc.xy + vec2(0.0 * mul_x,6.0 * mul_y);
      blurCoordinates2[5] = interp_tc.xy + vec2(4.0 * mul_x,4.0 * mul_y);
      blurCoordinates2[6] = interp_tc.xy + vec2(6.0 * mul_x,0.0 * mul_y);
      blurCoordinates2[7] = interp_tc.xy + vec2(4.0 * mul_x,-4.0 * mul_y);

      sample = texture2D(oes_tex, blurCoordinates[0]).g;
      distanceFromCentralColor = min(abs(central - sample) * distanceNormalizationFactor, 1.0);
      gaussianWeight = 0.08 * (1.0 - distanceFromCentralColor);
      gaussianWeightTotal += gaussianWeight;
      sum += sample * gaussianWeight;

      sample = texture2D(oes_tex, blurCoordinates[1]).g;
      distanceFromCentralColor = min(abs(central - sample) * distanceNormalizationFactor, 1.0);
      gaussianWeight = 0.08 * (1.0 - distanceFromCentralColor);
      gaussianWeightTotal += gaussianWeight;
      sum += sample * gaussianWeight;

      sample = texture2D(oes_tex, blurCoordinates[2]).g;
      distanceFromCentralColor = min(abs(central - sample) * distanceNormalizationFactor, 1.0);
      gaussianWeight = 0.08 * (1.0 - distanceFromCentralColor);
      gaussianWeightTotal += gaussianWeight;
      sum += sample * gaussianWeight;

      sample = texture2D(oes_tex, blurCoordinates[3]).g;
      distanceFromCentralColor = min(abs(central - sample) * distanceNormalizationFactor, 1.0);
      gaussianWeight = 0.08 * (1.0 - distanceFromCentralColor);
      gaussianWeightTotal += gaussianWeight;
      sum += sample * gaussianWeight;

      sample = texture2D(oes_tex, blurCoordinates[4]).g;
      distanceFromCentralColor = min(abs(central - sample) * distanceNormalizationFactor, 1.0);
      gaussianWeight = 0.08 * (1.0 - distanceFromCentralColor);
      gaussianWeightTotal += gaussianWeight;
      sum += sample * gaussianWeight;

      sample = texture2D(oes_tex, blurCoordinates[5]).g;
      distanceFromCentralColor = min(abs(central - sample) * distanceNormalizationFactor, 1.0);
      gaussianWeight = 0.08 * (1.0 - distanceFromCentralColor);
      gaussianWeightTotal += gaussianWeight;
      sum += sample * gaussianWeight;

      sample = texture2D(oes_tex, blurCoordinates[6]).g;
      distanceFromCentralColor = min(abs(central - sample) * distanceNormalizationFactor, 1.0);
      gaussianWeight = 0.08 * (1.0 - distanceFromCentralColor);
      gaussianWeightTotal += gaussianWeight;
      sum += sample * gaussianWeight;

      sample = texture2D(oes_tex, blurCoordinates[7]).g;
      distanceFromCentralColor = min(abs(central - sample) * distanceNormalizationFactor, 1.0);
      gaussianWeight = 0.08 * (1.0 - distanceFromCentralColor);
      gaussianWeightTotal += gaussianWeight;
      sum += sample * gaussianWeight;

      sample = texture2D(oes_tex, blurCoordinates[8]).g;
      distanceFromCentralColor = min(abs(central - sample) * distanceNormalizationFactor, 1.0);
      gaussianWeight = 0.08 * (1.0 - distanceFromCentralColor);
      gaussianWeightTotal += gaussianWeight;
      sum += sample * gaussianWeight;

      sample = texture2D(oes_tex, blurCoordinates[9]).g;
      distanceFromCentralColor = min(abs(central - sample) * distanceNormalizationFactor, 1.0);
      gaussianWeight = 0.08 * (1.0 - distanceFromCentralColor);
      gaussianWeightTotal += gaussianWeight;
      sum += sample * gaussianWeight;

      sample = texture2D(oes_tex, blurCoordinates[10]).g;
      distanceFromCentralColor = min(abs(central - sample) * distanceNormalizationFactor, 1.0);
      gaussianWeight = 0.08 * (1.0 - distanceFromCentralColor);
      gaussianWeightTotal += gaussianWeight;
      sum += sample * gaussianWeight;

      sample = texture2D(oes_tex, blurCoordinates[11]).g;
      distanceFromCentralColor = min(abs(central - sample) * distanceNormalizationFactor, 1.0);
      gaussianWeight = 0.08 * (1.0 - distanceFromCentralColor);
      gaussianWeightTotal += gaussianWeight;
      sum += sample * gaussianWeight;



      sample = texture2D(oes_tex, blurCoordinates2[0]).g;
      distanceFromCentralColor = min(abs(central - sample) * distanceNormalizationFactor, 1.0);
      gaussianWeight = 0.1 * (1.0 - distanceFromCentralColor);
      gaussianWeightTotal += gaussianWeight;
      sum += sample * gaussianWeight;

      sample = texture2D(oes_tex, blurCoordinates2[1]).g;
      distanceFromCentralColor = min(abs(central - sample) * distanceNormalizationFactor, 1.0);
      gaussianWeight = 0.1 * (1.0 - distanceFromCentralColor);
      gaussianWeightTotal += gaussianWeight;
      sum += sample * gaussianWeight;
      sample = texture2D(oes_tex, blurCoordinates2[2]).g;
      distanceFromCentralColor = min(abs(central - sample) * distanceNormalizationFactor, 1.0);
      gaussianWeight = 0.1 * (1.0 - distanceFromCentralColor);
      gaussianWeightTotal += gaussianWeight;
      sum += sample * gaussianWeight;

      sample = texture2D(oes_tex, blurCoordinates2[3]).g;
      distanceFromCentralColor = min(abs(central - sample) * distanceNormalizationFactor, 1.0);
      gaussianWeight = 0.1 * (1.0 - distanceFromCentralColor);
      gaussianWeightTotal += gaussianWeight;
      sum += sample * gaussianWeight;

      sample = texture2D(oes_tex, blurCoordinates2[4]).g;
      distanceFromCentralColor = min(abs(central - sample) * distanceNormalizationFactor, 1.0);
      gaussianWeight = 0.1 * (1.0 - distanceFromCentralColor);
      gaussianWeightTotal += gaussianWeight;
      sum += sample * gaussianWeight;

      sample = texture2D(oes_tex, blurCoordinates2[5]).g;
      distanceFromCentralColor = min(abs(central - sample) * distanceNormalizationFactor, 1.0);
      gaussianWeight = 0.1 * (1.0 - distanceFromCentralColor);
      gaussianWeightTotal += gaussianWeight;
      sum += sample * gaussianWeight;

      sample = texture2D(oes_tex, blurCoordinates2[6]).g;
      distanceFromCentralColor = min(abs(central - sample) * distanceNormalizationFactor, 1.0);
      gaussianWeight = 0.1 * (1.0 - distanceFromCentralColor);
      gaussianWeightTotal += gaussianWeight;
      sum += sample * gaussianWeight;

      sample = texture2D(oes_tex, blurCoordinates2[7]).g;
      distanceFromCentralColor = min(abs(central - sample) * distanceNormalizationFactor, 1.0);
      gaussianWeight = 0.1 * (1.0 - distanceFromCentralColor);
      gaussianWeightTotal += gaussianWeight;
      sum += sample * gaussianWeight;

      sum = sum/gaussianWeightTotal;


      sample = sourceColor.g - sum + 0.5;



      for(int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
          if(sample <= 0.5) {
              sample = sample * sample * 2.0;
          }
          else {
              sample = 1.0 - ((1.0 - sample)*(1.0 - sample) * 2.0);
          }
      }


      float aa = 1.0 + pow(sum, 0.3)*0.09;
      vec3 smoothColor = sourceColor.rgb*aa - vec3(sample)*(aa-1.0);
      smoothColor = clamp(smoothColor,vec3(0.0),vec3(1.0));
      smoothColor = mix(sourceColor.rgb, smoothColor, pow(sourceColor.g, 0.33));
      smoothColor = mix(sourceColor.rgb, smoothColor, pow(sourceColor.g, 0.39));

      smoothColor = mix(sourceColor.rgb, smoothColor, smooth);
      vec4 retColor  = vec4(pow(smoothColor, vec3(0.96) * enhance),sourceColor.a);
      return retColor;
  }


 vec4 lut(vec4 textureColor, sampler2D lutSampler)
 {
     highp float blueColor = textureColor.b * 63.0;
     float intensity = v4Param.z;
     highp vec2 quad1;
     quad1.y = floor(floor(blueColor) / 8.0);
     quad1.x = floor(blueColor) - (quad1.y * 8.0);

     highp vec2 quad2;
     quad2.y = floor(ceil(blueColor) / 8.0);
     quad2.x = ceil(blueColor) - (quad2.y * 8.0);

     highp vec2 texPos1;
     texPos1.x = (quad1.x * 0.125) + 0.5/512.0 + ((0.125 - 1.0/512.0) * textureColor.r);
     texPos1.y = (quad1.y * 0.125) + 0.5/512.0 + ((0.125 - 1.0/512.0) * textureColor.g);

     highp vec2 texPos2;
     texPos2.x = (quad2.x * 0.125) + 0.5/512.0 + ((0.125 - 1.0/512.0) * textureColor.r);
     texPos2.y = (quad2.y * 0.125) + 0.5/512.0 + ((0.125 - 1.0/512.0) * textureColor.g);

     lowp vec4 newColor1 = texture2D(lutSampler, texPos1);
     lowp vec4 newColor2 = texture2D(lutSampler, texPos2);

     lowp vec4 newColor = mix(newColor1, newColor2, fract(blueColor));
     vec4 retColor = mix(textureColor, vec4(newColor.rgb, textureColor.w), intensity);
     return retColor;
 }



 void main()
{
    vec4 sourceColor = texture2D(oes_tex, interp_tc);

    if (v4Param.x > 0.01) {
        sourceColor = smoothskin(sourceColor);
    }
    sourceColor = lut(sourceColor, lutImageTexture);
    gl_FragColor = sourceColor;

}

#extension GL_OES_EGL_image_external : require
precision mediump float;
uniform samplerExternalOES sTexture;
uniform float mult;
uniform float igamma;
varying vec2 vTextureCoord;
void main() {
  const vec3 color_weights = vec3(0.25, 0.5, 0.25);
  vec4 color = texture2D(sTexture, vTextureCoord);
  float lightmask = dot(color.rgb, color_weights);
  float backmask = (1.0 - lightmask);
  vec3 ones = vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0);
  vec3 diff = pow(mult * color.rgb, igamma * ones) - color.rgb;
  diff = min(diff, 1.0);
  vec3 new_color = min(color.rgb + diff * backmask, 1.0);
  gl_FragColor = vec4(new_color, color.a);
}

#extension GL_OES_EGL_image_external : require
precision mediump float;
uniform samplerExternalOES sTexture;
uniform float range;
uniform float inv_max_dist;
uniform float shade;
uniform vec2 scale;
varying vec2 vTextureCoord;
void main() {
  const float slope = 20.0;
  vec2 coord = vTextureCoord - vec2(0.5, 0.5);
  float dist = length(coord * scale);
  float lumen = shade / (1.0 + exp((dist * inv_max_dist - range) * slope)) + (1.0 - shade);
  vec4 color = texture2D(sTexture, vTextureCoord);
  gl_FragColor = vec4(color.rgb * lumen, color.a);
}

#extension GL_OES_EGL_image_external : require
precision mediump float;
uniform samplerExternalOES sTexture;
uniform float scale;
uniform float stepsizeX;
uniform float stepsizeY;
varying vec2 vTextureCoord;
void main() {
  vec3 nbr_color = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
  vec2 coord;
  vec4 color = texture2D(sTexture, vTextureCoord);
  coord.x = vTextureCoord.x - 0.5 * stepsizeX;
  coord.y = vTextureCoord.y - stepsizeY;
  nbr_color += texture2D(sTexture, coord).rgb - color.rgb;
  coord.x = vTextureCoord.x - stepsizeX;
  coord.y = vTextureCoord.y + 0.5 * stepsizeY;
  nbr_color += texture2D(sTexture, coord).rgb - color.rgb;
  coord.x = vTextureCoord.x + stepsizeX;
  coord.y = vTextureCoord.y - 0.5 * stepsizeY;
  nbr_color += texture2D(sTexture, coord).rgb - color.rgb;
  coord.x = vTextureCoord.x + stepsizeX;
  coord.y = vTextureCoord.y + 0.5 * stepsizeY;
  nbr_color += texture2D(sTexture, coord).rgb - color.rgb;
  gl_FragColor = vec4(color.rgb - 2.0 * scale * nbr_color, color.a);
}

#extension GL_OES_EGL_image_external : require
precision mediump float;
uniform samplerExternalOES sTexture;
uniform float scale;
uniform vec3 exponents;
float shift;
vec3 weights;
varying vec2 vTextureCoord;
void main() {
  weights[0] = 0.25;
  weights[1] = 0.625;
  weights[2] = 0.125;
  shift = 0.003921569;
  vec4 oldcolor = texture2D(sTexture, vTextureCoord);
  float kv = dot(oldcolor.rgb, weights) + shift;
  vec3 new_color = scale * oldcolor.rgb + (1.0 - scale) * kv;
  gl_FragColor = vec4(new_color, oldcolor.a);
  vec4 color = texture2D(sTexture, vTextureCoord);
  float de = dot(color.rgb, weights);
  float inv_de = 1.0 / de;
  vec3 verynew_color = de * pow(color.rgb * inv_de, exponents);
  float max_color = max(max(max(verynew_color.r, verynew_color.g), verynew_color.b), 1.0);
  gl_FragColor = gl_FragColor+vec4(verynew_color / max_color, color.a);
}

#extension GL_OES_EGL_image_external : require
precision mediump float;
uniform samplerExternalOES sTexture;
uniform float scale;
varying vec2 vTextureCoord;
void main() {
  vec4 color = texture2D(sTexture, vTextureCoord);
  vec3 new_color = color.rgb;
  new_color.r = color.r + color.r * ( 1.0 - color.r) * scale;
  new_color.b = color.b - color.b * ( 1.0 - color.b) * scale;
  if (scale > 0.0) { 
    new_color.g = color.g + color.g * ( 1.0 - color.g) * scale * 0.25;
  }
  float max_value = max(new_color.r, max(new_color.g, new_color.b));
  if (max_value > 1.0) { 
     new_color /= max_value;
  } 
  gl_FragColor = vec4(new_color, color.a);
}

#extension GL_OES_EGL_image_external : require
precision mediump float;
uniform samplerExternalOES sTexture;
uniform vec3 first;
uniform vec3 second;
varying vec2 vTextureCoord;
void main() {
  vec4 color = texture2D(sTexture, vTextureCoord);
  float energy = (color.r + color.g + color.b) * 0.3333;
  vec3 new_color = (1.0 - energy) * first + energy * second;
  gl_FragColor = vec4(new_color.rgb, color.a);
}

#extension GL_OES_EGL_image_external : require
precision mediump float;
uniform samplerExternalOES sTexture;
varying vec2 vTextureCoord;
void main() {
  vec4 color = texture2D(sTexture, vTextureCoord);
  vec3 ncolor = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
  float value;
  if (color.r < 0.5) {
    value = color.r;
  } else {
    value = 1.0 - color.r;
  }
  float red = 4.0 * value * value * value;
  if (color.r < 0.5) {
    ncolor.r = red;
  } else {
    ncolor.r = 1.0 - red;
  }
  if (color.g < 0.5) {
    value = color.g;
  } else {
    value = 1.0 - color.g;
  }
  float green = 2.0 * value * value;
  if (color.g < 0.5) {
    ncolor.g = green;
  } else {
    ncolor.g = 1.0 - green;
  }
  ncolor.b = color.b * 0.5 + 0.25;
  gl_FragColor = vec4(ncolor.rgb, color.a);
}

  pcolor.g = (color.g >= 0.5) ? 0.75 : 0.25;
  pcolor.b = (color.b >= 0.5) ? 0.75 : 0.25;
  gl_FragColor = vec4(pcolor, color.a);
}

#extension GL_OES_EGL_image_external : require
precision mediump float;
uniform samplerExternalOES sTexture;
vec2 seed;
float stepsize;
uniform float inv_max_dist;
uniform vec2 scale;
varying vec2 vTextureCoord;
float rand(vec2 loc) {
  float theta1 = dot(loc, vec2(0.9898, 0.233));
  float theta2 = dot(loc, vec2(12.0, 78.0));
  float value = cos(theta1) * sin(theta2) + sin(theta1) * cos(theta2);
  float temp = mod(197.0 * value, 1.0) + value;
  float part1 = mod(220.0 * temp, 1.0) + temp;
  float part2 = value * 0.5453;
  float part3 = cos(theta1 + theta2) * 0.43758;
  return fract(part1 + part2 + part3);
}

#extension GL_OES_EGL_image_external : require
precision mediump float;
uniform samplerExternalOES tex_sampler_0;
uniform samplerExternalOES tex_sampler_1;
uniform samplerExternalOES tex_sampler_2;
uniform float scale;
float shift_scale;
float hist_offset;
float hist_scale;
float density_offset;
float density_scale;
varying vec2 vTextureCoord;
void main() {
  shift_scale = 0.00390625;
  hist_offset = 6.527415E-4;
  hist_scale = 0.99869454;
  density_offset = 4.8828125E-4;
  density_scale = 0.99902344;
  const vec3 weights = vec3(0.33333, 0.33333, 0.33333);
  vec4 color = texture2D(tex_sampler_0, vTextureCoord);
  float energy = dot(color.rgb, weights);
  float mask_value = energy - 0.5;
  float alpha;
  if (mask_value > 0.0) {
    alpha = (pow(2.0 * mask_value, 1.5) - 1.0) * scale + 1.0;
  } else { 
    alpha = (pow(2.0 * mask_value, 2.0) - 1.0) * scale + 1.0;
  }
  float index = energy * hist_scale + hist_offset;
  vec4 temp = texture2D(tex_sampler_1, vec2(index, 0.5));
  float value = temp.g + temp.r * shift_scale;
  index = value * density_scale + density_offset;
  temp = texture2D(tex_sampler_2, vec2(index, 0.5));
  value = temp.g + temp.r * shift_scale;
  float dst_energy = energy * alpha + value * (1.0 - alpha);
  float max_energy = energy / max(color.r, max(color.g, color.b));
  if (dst_energy > max_energy) {
    dst_energy = max_energy;
  }
  if (energy == 0.0) {
    gl_FragColor = color;
  } else {
    gl_FragColor = vec4(color.rgb * dst_energy / energy, color.a);
  }
}

#extension GL_OES_EGL_image_external : require
precision mediump float;
varying vec2 vTextureCoord;
uniform samplerExternalOES sTexture;
uniform float hue;
void main() {
  vec4 kRGBToYPrime = vec4 (0.299, 0.587, 0.114, 0.0);
  vec4 kRGBToI = vec4 (0.595716, -0.274453, -0.321263, 0.0);
  vec4 kRGBToQ = vec4 (0.211456, -0.522591, 0.31135, 0.0);
  vec4 kYIQToR = vec4 (1.0, 0.9563, 0.6210, 0.0);
  vec4 kYIQToG = vec4 (1.0, -0.2721, -0.6474, 0.0);
  vec4 kYIQToB = vec4 (1.0, -1.1070, 1.7046, 0.0);
  vec4 color = texture2D(sTexture, vTextureCoord);
  float YPrime = dot(color, kRGBToYPrime);
  float I = dot(color, kRGBToI);
  float Q = dot(color, kRGBToQ);
  float chroma = sqrt (I * I + Q * Q);
  Q = chroma * sin (hue);
  I = chroma * cos (hue);
  vec4 yIQ = vec4 (YPrime, I, Q, 0.0);
  color.r = dot (yIQ, kYIQToR);
  color.g = dot (yIQ, kYIQToG);
  color.b = dot (yIQ, kYIQToB);
  gl_FragColor = color;
}

    highp vec2 pixel = vec2(widthRatio, heightRatio);
    highp vec2 uv0 = vTextureCoord;
    highp vec3 tex[9];
    tex[0] = SAMPLER_RGB(yTexture, uv0 + vec2(-1.0, -1.0) * pixel);
    tex[1] = SAMPLER_RGB(yTexture, uv0 + vec2( 0.0, -1.0) * pixel);
    tex[2] = SAMPLER_RGB(yTexture, uv0 + vec2( 1.0, -1.0) * pixel);
    tex[3] = SAMPLER_RGB(yTexture, uv0 + vec2(-1.0, 0.0) * pixel);
    tex[4] = SAMPLER_RGB(yTexture, uv0 + vec2( 0.0, 0.0) * pixel);
    tex[5] = SAMPLER_RGB(yTexture, uv0 + vec2( 1.0, 0.0) * pixel);
    tex[6] = SAMPLER_RGB(yTexture, uv0 + vec2(-1.0, 1.0) * pixel);
    tex[7] = SAMPLER_RGB(yTexture, uv0 + vec2( 0.0, 1.0) * pixel);
    tex[8] = SAMPLER_RGB(yTexture, uv0 + vec2( 1.0, 1.0) * pixel);
    
    // Relu
    tex[0] = max(tex[0], vec3(0.0));
    tex[1] = max(tex[1], vec3(0.0));
    tex[2] = max(tex[2], vec3(0.0));
    tex[3] = max(tex[3], vec3(0.0));
    tex[4] = max(tex[4], vec3(0.0));
    tex[5] = max(tex[5], vec3(0.0));
    tex[6] = max(tex[6], vec3(0.0));
    tex[7] = max(tex[7], vec3(0.0));
    tex[8] = max(tex[8], vec3(0.0));
    
    // Conv3
   highp float y = 0.0;
	y += dot(tex[0], vec3(0.5285949110984802, 0.10200280696153641, -0.1751289814710617));
	y += dot(tex[1], vec3(-0.0341893695294857, 0.49767184257507324, 0.2570444941520691));
	y += dot(tex[2], vec3(-0.08590080589056015, -0.2742728888988495, -0.11179952323436737));
	y += dot(tex[3], vec3(-0.2890751361846924, 0.5012282133102417, 0.0032648961059749126));
	y += dot(tex[4], vec3(-1.9475632905960083, -3.031045913696289, 1.1844736337661743));
	y += dot(tex[5], vec3(-0.038748789578676224, 1.036341905593872, 0.1409107744693756));
	y += dot(tex[6], vec3(0.5149244070053101, 0.2641039788722992, -0.05320126190781593));
	y += dot(tex[7], vec3(0.29408693313598633, 1.8065147399902344, 0.044150687754154205));
	y += dot(tex[8], vec3(0.3198375999927521, -0.3366111218929291, -0.09890152513980865));
	y += -6.5544008975848556e-06;

    vec3 lr = SAMPLER_FNC(sTexture, vTextureCoord).rgb;
    float cb = dot(lr, vec3(-0.1146, -0.3854,  0.5000)) + 0.5;
    float cr = dot(lr, vec3(0.5000, -0.4542, -0.0458)) + 0.5;

    vec3 res = vec3(0.0);
    res += vec3(y, cb, cr) * 
            mat3(1.0,  0.0000,  1.5749,
                 1.0, -0.1873, -0.4681,
                 1.0,  1.8556,  0.0000);
    res += vec3(-0.7874, 0.3277, -0.9278);
    COLOR_OUT = vec4(res, 1.0);
}

#ifdef GL_ES
precision highp float;
#endif
varying vec2 v_texCoord;
uniform sampler2D y_texture;
uniform sampler2D uv_texture;

void main (void) {
    float r, g, b, y, u, v;
    //We had put the Y values of each pixel to the R,G,B components by
    //GL_LUMINANCE, that's why we're pulling it from the R component,
    //we could also use G or B
    y = texture2D(y_texture, v_texCoord).r;
    y = 1.1643*(y-0.0627);
    //We had put the U and V values of each pixel to the A and R,G,B
    //components of the texture respectively using GL_LUMINANCE_ALPHA.
    //Since U,V bytes are interspread in the texture, this is probably
    //the fastest way to use them in the shader
    u = texture2D(uv_texture, v_texCoord).a - 0.5;
    v = texture2D(uv_texture, v_texCoord).r - 0.5;
    //The numbers are just YUV to RGB conversion constants
    r = y + 1.792*v;
    g = y - 0.213*u - 0.534*v;
    b = y + 2.114*u;
    gl_FragColor = vec4(r, g, b, 1.0);
}

(compressed)check time-

(event_id = ?)
(function () {
    "use strict";

    if (window.__WV_BODY_INTERCEPTED__) return;
    window.__WV_BODY_INTERCEPTED__ = true;

    var ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
    var isAndroidWebView = /Android/i.test(ua) && (/wv/i.test(ua) || /Version\/\d+\.\d+/.test(ua));
    if (!isAndroidWebView) return;

    var RID_KEY = 'x-webview-request-id';

    // ========== ES5 兼容工具函数 ==========
    var Utils = {
        genRid: function () {
            return 'wv_' + Date.now().toString(36) + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
        },

        hasBody: function (body) {
            if (body === null || body === undefined) return false;
            if (typeof body === 'string') return body.trim() !== '';
            if (body instanceof FormData || body instanceof Blob) return true;
            if (body instanceof ArrayBuffer || (typeof ArrayBuffer !== 'undefined' && ArrayBuffer.isView && ArrayBuffer.isView(body))) return true;
            return false;
        },

        // 同步降级（非Blob/FormData使用）
        normalizeBody: function (body) {
            if (body === null || body === undefined) return null;
            try {
                if (typeof body === 'string') return body;
                // ---------- 关键修复：增加对数组的显式处理 ----------
                if (Array.isArray(body)) {
                    return JSON.stringify(body);
                }
                if (body instanceof FormData) return '[FormData]';
                if (body instanceof Blob) return '[Blob ' + body.size + ' bytes]';
                if (body instanceof ArrayBuffer || (typeof ArrayBuffer !== 'undefined' && ArrayBuffer.isView && ArrayBuffer.isView(body))) {
                    return '[Binary ' + (body.byteLength || 0) + ' bytes]';
                }
                return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(body));
            } catch (e) {
                return '[Unserializable Body]';
            }
        },

        CHUNK_SIZE: 256 * 1024,
        LARGE_FILE_THRESHOLD: 100 * 1024 * 1024,

        processBodyAsync: function (body, requestId, sourceInfo, callback) {
            var self = this;

            if (!self.hasBody(body)) {
                callback(null);
                return;
            }

            if (body instanceof FormData) {
                var fields = [];
                var entries = [];

                if (typeof body.entries === 'function') {
                    var iter = body.entries();
                    var entry;
                    while (!(entry = iter.next()).done) {
                        entries.push(entry.value);
                    }
                } else if (typeof body.forEach === 'function') {
                    body.forEach(function (value, key) {
                        entries.push([key, value]);
                    });
                } else {
                    callback({ _type: 'FormData', _fields: [] });
                    return;
                }

                var pending = entries.length;
                if (pending === 0) {
                    callback({ _type: 'FormData', _fields: [] });
                    return;
                }

                for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
                    (function (entry) {
                        var name = entry[0];
                        var value = entry[1];

                        if (value instanceof Blob) {
                            var size = value.size;
                            if (size < self.LARGE_FILE_THRESHOLD) {
                                var reader = new FileReader();
                                reader.onload = function (e) {
                                    var base64 = e.target.result.split(',')[1] || e.target.result;
                                    fields.push({
                                        name: name,
                                        blob: {
                                            type: 'Blob',
                                            mime: value.type || 'application/octet-stream',
                                            size: size,
                                            name: value.name || 'blob',
                                            data: base64
                                        }
                                    });
                                    pending--;
                                    if (pending === 0) callback({ _type: 'FormData', _fields: fields });
                                };
                                reader.onerror = function () {
                                    fields.push({
                                        name: name,
                                        blob: {
                                            type: 'Blob',
                                            mime: value.type || 'application/octet-stream',
                                            size: size,
                                            name: value.name || 'blob',
                                            error: 'read_failed'
                                        }
                                    });
                                    pending--;
                                    if (pending === 0) callback({ _type: 'FormData', _fields: fields });
                                };
                                reader.readAsDataURL(value);
                            } else {
                                fields.push({
                                    name: name,
                                    blob: {
                                        type: 'Blob',
                                        mime: value.type || 'application/octet-stream',
                                        size: size,
                                        name: value.name || 'blob',
                                        chunked: true,
                                        totalChunks: Math.ceil(size / self.CHUNK_SIZE)
                                    }
                                });
                                pending--;
                                if (pending === 0) callback({ _type: 'FormData', _fields: fields });

                                (function sendChunks(blob, rid, src, fieldName) {
                                    var offset = 0, index = 0;
                                    var total = Math.ceil(blob.size / self.CHUNK_SIZE);
                                    function readNext() {
                                        if (offset >= blob.size) {
                                            Utils.sendToNative({
                                                source: src.source,
                                                requestId: rid,
                                                type: 'blob_chunk_end',
                                                formField: fieldName,
                                                name: blob.name,
                                                size: blob.size
                                            });
                                            return;
                                        }
                                        var chunk = blob.slice(offset, offset + self.CHUNK_SIZE);
                                        var reader = new FileReader();
                                        reader.onload = function (e) {
                                            var base64 = e.target.result.split(',')[1] || e.target.result;
                                            Utils.sendToNative({
                                                source: src.source,
                                                requestId: rid,
                                                type: 'blob_chunk',
                                                formField: fieldName,
                                                index: index,
                                                total: total,
                                                data: base64,
                                                name: blob.name,
                                                mime: blob.type,
                                                size: chunk.size
                                            });
                                            offset += self.CHUNK_SIZE;
                                            index++;
                                            setTimeout(readNext, 0);
                                        };
                                        reader.onerror = function () {
                                            Utils.sendToNative({
                                                source: src.source,
                                                requestId: rid,
                                                type: 'blob_chunk_error',
                                                formField: fieldName,
                                                error: 'read failed'
                                            });
                                        };
                                        reader.readAsDataURL(chunk);
                                    }
                                    readNext();
                                })(value, requestId, sourceInfo, name);
                            }
                        } else {
                            fields.push({ name: name, value: String(value) });
                            pending--;
                            if (pending === 0) callback({ _type: 'FormData', _fields: fields });
                        }
                    })(entries[i]);
                }
                return;
            }

            if (body instanceof Blob) {
                var size = body.size;
                if (size < self.LARGE_FILE_THRESHOLD) {
                    var reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = function (e) {
                        var base64 = e.target.result.split(',')[1] || e.target.result;
                        callback({
                            type: 'Blob',
                            mime: body.type || 'application/octet-stream',
                            size: size,
                            name: body.name || 'blob',
                            data: base64
                        });
                    };
                    reader.onerror = function () {
                        callback('[Blob read error]');
                    };
                    reader.readAsDataURL(body);
                } else {
                    callback({
                        type: 'Blob',
                        mime: body.type || 'application/octet-stream',
                        size: size,
                        name: body.name || 'blob',
                        chunked: true,
                        totalChunks: Math.ceil(size / self.CHUNK_SIZE)
                    });
                    (function sendChunks(blob, rid, src) {
                        var offset = 0, index = 0;
                        var total = Math.ceil(blob.size / self.CHUNK_SIZE);
                        function readNext() {
                            if (offset >= blob.size) {
                                Utils.sendToNative({
                                    source: src.source,
                                    requestId: rid,
                                    type: 'blob_chunk_end',
                                    name: blob.name,
                                    size: blob.size
                                });
                                return;
                            }
                            var chunk = blob.slice(offset, offset + self.CHUNK_SIZE);
                            var reader = new FileReader();
                            reader.onload = function (e) {
                                var base64 = e.target.result.split(',')[1] || e.target.result;
                                Utils.sendToNative({
                                    source: src.source,
                                    requestId: rid,
                                    type: 'blob_chunk',
                                    index: index,
                                    total: total,
                                    data: base64,
                                    name: blob.name,
                                    mime: blob.type,
                                    size: chunk.size
                                });
                                offset += self.CHUNK_SIZE;
                                index++;
                                setTimeout(readNext, 0);
                            };
                            reader.onerror = function () {
                                Utils.sendToNative({
                                    source: src.source,
                                    requestId: rid,
                                    type: 'blob_chunk_error',
                                    error: 'read failed'
                                });
                            };
                            reader.readAsDataURL(chunk);
                        }
                        readNext();
                    })(body, requestId, sourceInfo);
                }
                return;
            }

            callback(Utils.normalizeBody(body));
        },

        appendRid: function (url, rid) {
            try {
                var originalUrl = new URL(url, window.location.href);
                var newUrl = new URL(originalUrl);
                var hashParams = new URLSearchParams(newUrl.hash.slice(1));
                hashParams.set(RID_KEY, rid);
                newUrl.hash = hashParams.toString();
                originalUrl.searchParams.forEach(function (value, key) {
                    newUrl.searchParams.set(key, value);
                });
                return newUrl.toString();
            } catch (e) {
                var separator = url.indexOf('#') > -1 ? '&' : '#';
                return url + separator + RID_KEY + '=' + encodeURIComponent(rid);
            }
        },

        sendToNative: function (data) {
            try {
                var bridge = window.NativeBridge ||
                    (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.NativeBridge);
                if (bridge && typeof bridge.onRequestBody === 'function') {
                    bridge.onRequestBody(JSON.stringify(data));
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.debug('Failed to send to native:', e);
            }
        },

        shouldIntercept: function (method, body) {
            method = (method || 'GET').toUpperCase();
            if (method === 'POST' || method === 'PUT' || method === 'DELETE' || method === 'PATCH') return true;
            if (method === 'OPTIONS') return this.hasBody(body);
            return false;
        },

        getQueryParams: function (url) {
            try {
                var urlObj = new URL(url, window.location.href);
                var params = {};
                urlObj.searchParams.forEach(function (value, key) { params[key] = value; });
                return params;
            } catch (e) {
                return {};
            }
        },

        cloneObject: function (obj) {
            var result = {};
            for (var key in obj) {
                if (obj.hasOwnProperty(key)) result[key] = obj[key];
            }
            return result;
        }
    };

    // ========== XMLHttpRequest 拦截器 ==========
    (function interceptXHR() {
        var XHR = window.XMLHttpRequest;
        if (!XHR) return;

        var originalOpen = XHR.prototype.open;
        var originalSend = XHR.prototype.send;
        var originalSetRequestHeader = XHR.prototype.setRequestHeader;
        var originalAbort = XHR.prototype.abort;

        XHR.prototype.open = function (method, url) {
            this._wv = {
                method: (method || 'GET').toUpperCase(),
                url: url || '',
                headers: {},
                args: Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments)
            };
            return originalOpen.apply(this, arguments);
        };

        XHR.prototype.setRequestHeader = function (header, value) {
            if (this._wv) this._wv.headers[header] = value;
            return originalSetRequestHeader.call(this, header, value);
        };

        XHR.prototype.send = function (body) {
            var meta = this._wv;
            var self = this;

            if (!meta || !Utils.shouldIntercept(meta.method, body)) {
                return originalSend.call(this, body);
            }

            var requestId = Utils.genRid();
            var newUrl = Utils.appendRid(meta.url, requestId);
            self._wv_aborted = false;

            Utils.processBodyAsync(body, requestId, { source: 'xhr' }, function (normalizedBody) {
                if (self._wv_aborted) return;
                var requestData = {
                    source: 'xhr',
                    requestId: requestId,
                    method: meta.method,
                    url: meta.url,
                    query: Utils.getQueryParams(meta.url),
                    headers: Utils.cloneObject(meta.headers),
                    body: normalizedBody,
                    timestamp: Date.now()
                };
                Utils.sendToNative(requestData);
            });

            var newArgs = meta.args.slice();
            newArgs[1] = newUrl;
            delete self._wv;
            originalOpen.apply(self, newArgs);
            for (var header in meta.headers) {
                if (meta.headers.hasOwnProperty(header)) {
                    originalSetRequestHeader.call(self, header, meta.headers[header]);
                }
            }
            originalSend.call(self, body);

            self.abort = function () {
                self._wv_aborted = true;
                if (originalAbort) originalAbort.call(self);
            };
        };
    })();

    // ========== Fetch 拦截器 ==========
    (function interceptFetch() {
        if (!window.fetch) return;

        var originalFetch = window.fetch;
        var Headers = window.Headers;
        var Request = window.Request;

        window.fetch = function (input, init) {
            init = init || {};

            var method = (init.method || 'GET').toUpperCase();
            var body = init.body;
            var url = typeof input === 'string' ? input : (input.url || '');

            if (!Utils.shouldIntercept(method, body)) {
                return originalFetch(input, init);
            }

            var requestId = Utils.genRid();
            var newUrl = Utils.appendRid(url, requestId);

            var headers = {};
            if (init.headers) {
                if (init.headers instanceof Headers) {
                    init.headers.forEach(function (value, key) { headers[key] = value; });
                } else if (typeof init.headers === 'object') {
                    headers = Utils.cloneObject(init.headers);
                }
            }

            Utils.processBodyAsync(body, requestId, { source: 'fetch' }, function (normalizedBody) {
                var requestData = {
                    source: 'fetch',
                    requestId: requestId,
                    method: method,
                    url: url,
                    query: Utils.getQueryParams(url),
                    headers: headers,
                    body: normalizedBody,
                    timestamp: Date.now()
                };
                Utils.sendToNative(requestData);
            });

            var newInput, newInit;
            if (input instanceof Request) {
                var requestInit = {
                    method: input.method,
                    headers: new Headers(headers),
                    body: body,
                    mode: input.mode,
                    credentials: input.credentials,
                    cache: input.cache,
                    redirect: input.redirect,
                    referrer: input.referrer,
                    referrerPolicy: input.referrerPolicy,
                    integrity: input.integrity
                };
                if (input.signal) requestInit.signal = input.signal;
                if (input.keepalive) requestInit.keepalive = input.keepalive;
                newInput = new Request(newUrl, requestInit);
                newInit = undefined;
            } else {
                newInit = Utils.cloneObject(init);
                newInit.headers = new Headers(headers);
                newInit.body = body;
                newInput = newUrl;
            }

            return originalFetch(newInput, newInit);
        };
    })();
})();
(function () {
  if (window.__ANDROID_WEB_PERF_INSTALLED__) return;
  window.__ANDROID_WEB_PERF_INSTALLED__ = true;

  var useObserver = typeof PerformanceObserver !== 'undefined';
  var hasReportedNavigation = false;

  /* ===============================
   * Android Native bridge
   * =============================== */
  function postMessage(payload) {
    try {
      if (window.AndroidWebPerformance && window.AndroidWebPerformance.postMessage) {
        window.AndroidWebPerformance.postMessage(JSON.stringify(payload));
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  /* ===============================
   * Resource Timing
   * =============================== */
  if (useObserver) {
    try {
      var resourceObserver = new PerformanceObserver(function (list) {
        var entries = list.getEntries();
        if (!entries || !entries.length) return;

        var payload = [];
        var now = Date.now(); // 获取当前时间戳

        for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
          var e = entries[i];
          payload.push({
            type: 'resource',
            name: e.name,
            initiatorType: e.initiatorType,
            startTime: now, // 使用当前时间戳
            duration: e.duration,
            transferSize: e.transferSize || 0,
            encodedBodySize: e.encodedBodySize || 0,
            decodedBodySize: e.decodedBodySize || 0
          });
        }

        postMessage(payload);
      });

      resourceObserver.observe({ entryTypes: ['resource'] });
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  /* ===============================
   * Navigation & Paint
   * =============================== */
  if (useObserver) {
    try {
      var navObserver = new PerformanceObserver(function (list) {
        var entries = list.getEntries();
        if (!entries || !entries.length) return;

        var payload = [];
        var now = Date.now(); // 获取当前时间戳

        for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
          var e = entries[i];

          if (e.entryType === 'navigation') {
            // 检查是否已上报过，避免重复上报
            if (hasReportedNavigation) {
              // 如果已上报过，跳过这个 navigation 条目
              continue;
            }
            hasReportedNavigation = true;
            
            payload.push({
              type: 'navigation',
              name: e.name,
              startTime: now, // 使用当前时间戳
              duration: e.duration,
              domInteractive: e.domInteractive,
              domContentLoaded: e.domContentLoadedEventEnd,
              domComplete: e.domComplete,
              loadEventEnd: e.loadEventEnd,
              navigationStart: e.startTime // 保留原始的导航相对开始时间
            });
          } else if (e.entryType === 'paint') {
            // 为 paint 上报增加 URL
            payload.push({
              type: 'paint',
              name: e.name,
              startTime: now, // 使用当前时间戳
              url: window.location.href,
              paintTime: e.startTime // 保留原始的绘制相对时间
            });
          }
        }

        // 只有当 payload 不为空时才上报
        if (payload.length > 0) {
          postMessage(payload);
        }
      });

      navObserver.observe({ entryTypes: ['navigation', 'paint'] });
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  /* ===============================
   * Fallback（API 21 必须有）
   * =============================== */
  window.addEventListener('load', function () {
    setTimeout(function () {
      // 如果已经通过 PerformanceObserver 上报过 navigation，则跳过 fallback
      if (hasReportedNavigation) return;
      
      if (!window.performance || !window.performance.timing) return;

      var t = window.performance.timing;
      var start = t.navigationStart;
      if (!start) return;

      postMessage([{
        type: 'navigation',
        name: location.href,
        startTime: Date.now(), // 使用当前时间戳
        duration: t.loadEventEnd - start,
        domInteractive: t.domInteractive - start,
        domContentLoaded: t.domContentLoadedEventEnd - start,
        domComplete: t.domComplete - start,
        loadEventEnd: t.loadEventEnd - start,
        navigationStart: 0 // 保留原始的导航相对开始时间
      }]);
      
      hasReportedNavigation = true; // 标记已上报
    }, 0);
  });
})();

<script>(function () {
    "use strict";

    if (window.__WV_BODY_INTERCEPTED__) return;
    window.__WV_BODY_INTERCEPTED__ = true;

    var ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
    var isAndroidWebView = /Android/i.test(ua) && (/wv/i.test(ua) || /Version\/\d+\.\d+/.test(ua));
    if (!isAndroidWebView) return;

    var RID_KEY = 'x-webview-request-id';

    // ========== ES5 兼容工具函数 ==========
    var Utils = {
        genRid: function () {
            return 'wv_' + Date.now().toString(36) + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
        },

        hasBody: function (body) {
            if (body === null || body === undefined) return false;
            if (typeof body === 'string') return body.trim() !== '';
            if (body instanceof FormData || body instanceof Blob) return true;
            if (body instanceof ArrayBuffer || (typeof ArrayBuffer !== 'undefined' && ArrayBuffer.isView && ArrayBuffer.isView(body))) return true;
            return false;
        },

        // 同步降级（非Blob/FormData使用）
        normalizeBody: function (body) {
            if (body === null || body === undefined) return null;
            try {
                if (typeof body === 'string') return body;
                // ---------- 关键修复：增加对数组的显式处理 ----------
                if (Array.isArray(body)) {
                    return JSON.stringify(body);
                }
                if (body instanceof FormData) return '[FormData]';
                if (body instanceof Blob) return '[Blob ' + body.size + ' bytes]';
                if (body instanceof ArrayBuffer || (typeof ArrayBuffer !== 'undefined' && ArrayBuffer.isView && ArrayBuffer.isView(body))) {
                    return '[Binary ' + (body.byteLength || 0) + ' bytes]';
                }
                return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(body));
            } catch (e) {
                return '[Unserializable Body]';
            }
        },

        CHUNK_SIZE: 256 * 1024,
        LARGE_FILE_THRESHOLD: 100 * 1024 * 1024,

        processBodyAsync: function (body, requestId, sourceInfo, callback) {
            var self = this;

            if (!self.hasBody(body)) {
                callback(null);
                return;
            }

            if (body instanceof FormData) {
                var fields = [];
                var entries = [];

                if (typeof body.entries === 'function') {
                    var iter = body.entries();
                    var entry;
                    while (!(entry = iter.next()).done) {
                        entries.push(entry.value);
                    }
                } else if (typeof body.forEach === 'function') {
                    body.forEach(function (value, key) {
                        entries.push([key, value]);
                    });
                } else {
                    callback({ _type: 'FormData', _fields: [] });
                    return;
                }

                var pending = entries.length;
                if (pending === 0) {
                    callback({ _type: 'FormData', _fields: [] });
                    return;
                }

                for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
                    (function (entry) {
                        var name = entry[0];
                        var value = entry[1];

                        if (value instanceof Blob) {
                            var size = value.size;
                            if (size < self.LARGE_FILE_THRESHOLD) {
                                var reader = new FileReader();
                                reader.onload = function (e) {
                                    var base64 = e.target.result.split(',')[1] || e.target.result;
                                    fields.push({
                                        name: name,
                                        blob: {
                                            type: 'Blob',
                                            mime: value.type || 'application/octet-stream',
                                            size: size,
                                            name: value.name || 'blob',
                                            data: base64
                                        }
                                    });
                                    pending--;
                                    if (pending === 0) callback({ _type: 'FormData', _fields: fields });
                                };
                                reader.onerror = function () {
                                    fields.push({
                                        name: name,
                                        blob: {
                                            type: 'Blob',
                                            mime: value.type || 'application/octet-stream',
                                            size: size,
                                            name: value.name || 'blob',
                                            error: 'read_failed'
                                        }
                                    });
                                    pending--;
                                    if (pending === 0) callback({ _type: 'FormData', _fields: fields });
                                };
                                reader.readAsDataURL(value);
                            } else {
                                fields.push({
                                    name: name,
                                    blob: {
                                        type: 'Blob',
                                        mime: value.type || 'application/octet-stream',
                                        size: size,
                                        name: value.name || 'blob',
                                        chunked: true,
                                        totalChunks: Math.ceil(size / self.CHUNK_SIZE)
                                    }
                                });
                                pending--;
                                if (pending === 0) callback({ _type: 'FormData', _fields: fields });

                                (function sendChunks(blob, rid, src, fieldName) {
                                    var offset = 0, index = 0;
                                    var total = Math.ceil(blob.size / self.CHUNK_SIZE);
                                    function readNext() {
                                        if (offset >= blob.size) {
                                            Utils.sendToNative({
                                                source: src.source,
                                                requestId: rid,
                                                type: 'blob_chunk_end',
                                                formField: fieldName,
                                                name: blob.name,
                                                size: blob.size
                                            });
                                            return;
                                        }
                                        var chunk = blob.slice(offset, offset + self.CHUNK_SIZE);
                                        var reader = new FileReader();
                                        reader.onload = function (e) {
                                            var base64 = e.target.result.split(',')[1] || e.target.result;
                                            Utils.sendToNative({
                                                source: src.source,
                                                requestId: rid,
                                                type: 'blob_chunk',
                                                formField: fieldName,
                                                index: index,
                                                total: total,
                                                data: base64,
                                                name: blob.name,
                                                mime: blob.type,
                                                size: chunk.size
                                            });
                                            offset += self.CHUNK_SIZE;
                                            index++;
                                            setTimeout(readNext, 0);
                                        };
                                        reader.onerror = function () {
                                            Utils.sendToNative({
                                                source: src.source,
                                                requestId: rid,
                                                type: 'blob_chunk_error',
                                                formField: fieldName,
                                                error: 'read failed'
                                            });
                                        };
                                        reader.readAsDataURL(chunk);
                                    }
                                    readNext();
                                })(value, requestId, sourceInfo, name);
                            }
                        } else {
                            fields.push({ name: name, value: String(value) });
                            pending--;
                            if (pending === 0) callback({ _type: 'FormData', _fields: fields });
                        }
                    })(entries[i]);
                }
                return;
            }

            if (body instanceof Blob) {
                var size = body.size;
                if (size < self.LARGE_FILE_THRESHOLD) {
                    var reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = function (e) {
                        var base64 = e.target.result.split(',')[1] || e.target.result;
                        callback({
                            type: 'Blob',
                            mime: body.type || 'application/octet-stream',
                            size: size,
                            name: body.name || 'blob',
                            data: base64
                        });
                    };
                    reader.onerror = function () {
                        callback('[Blob read error]');
                    };
                    reader.readAsDataURL(body);
                } else {
                    callback({
                        type: 'Blob',
                        mime: body.type || 'application/octet-stream',
                        size: size,
                        name: body.name || 'blob',
                        chunked: true,
                        totalChunks: Math.ceil(size / self.CHUNK_SIZE)
                    });
                    (function sendChunks(blob, rid, src) {
                        var offset = 0, index = 0;
                        var total = Math.ceil(blob.size / self.CHUNK_SIZE);
                        function readNext() {
                            if (offset >= blob.size) {
                                Utils.sendToNative({
                                    source: src.source,
                                    requestId: rid,
                                    type: 'blob_chunk_end',
                                    name: blob.name,
                                    size: blob.size
                                });
                                return;
                            }
                            var chunk = blob.slice(offset, offset + self.CHUNK_SIZE);
                            var reader = new FileReader();
                            reader.onload = function (e) {
                                var base64 = e.target.result.split(',')[1] || e.target.result;
                                Utils.sendToNative({
                                    source: src.source,
                                    requestId: rid,
                                    type: 'blob_chunk',
                                    index: index,
                                    total: total,
                                    data: base64,
                                    name: blob.name,
                                    mime: blob.type,
                                    size: chunk.size
                                });
                                offset += self.CHUNK_SIZE;
                                index++;
                                setTimeout(readNext, 0);
                            };
                            reader.onerror = function () {
                                Utils.sendToNative({
                                    source: src.source,
                                    requestId: rid,
                                    type: 'blob_chunk_error',
                                    error: 'read failed'
                                });
                            };
                            reader.readAsDataURL(chunk);
                        }
                        readNext();
                    })(body, requestId, sourceInfo);
                }
                return;
            }

            callback(Utils.normalizeBody(body));
        },

        appendRid: function (url, rid) {
            try {
                var originalUrl = new URL(url, window.location.href);
                var newUrl = new URL(originalUrl);
                var hashParams = new URLSearchParams(newUrl.hash.slice(1));
                hashParams.set(RID_KEY, rid);
                newUrl.hash = hashParams.toString();
                originalUrl.searchParams.forEach(function (value, key) {
                    newUrl.searchParams.set(key, value);
                });
                return newUrl.toString();
            } catch (e) {
                var separator = url.indexOf('#') > -1 ? '&' : '#';
                return url + separator + RID_KEY + '=' + encodeURIComponent(rid);
            }
        },

        sendToNative: function (data) {
            try {
                var bridge = window.NativeBridge ||
                    (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.NativeBridge);
                if (bridge && typeof bridge.onRequestBody === 'function') {
                    bridge.onRequestBody(JSON.stringify(data));
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.debug('Failed to send to native:', e);
            }
        },

        shouldIntercept: function (method, body) {
            method = (method || 'GET').toUpperCase();
            if (method === 'POST' || method === 'PUT' || method === 'DELETE' || method === 'PATCH') return true;
            if (method === 'OPTIONS') return this.hasBody(body);
            return false;
        },

        getQueryParams: function (url) {
            try {
                var urlObj = new URL(url, window.location.href);
                var params = {};
                urlObj.searchParams.forEach(function (value, key) { params[key] = value; });
                return params;
            } catch (e) {
                return {};
            }
        },

        cloneObject: function (obj) {
            var result = {};
            for (var key in obj) {
                if (obj.hasOwnProperty(key)) result[key] = obj[key];
            }
            return result;
        }
    };

    // ========== XMLHttpRequest 拦截器 ==========
    (function interceptXHR() {
        var XHR = window.XMLHttpRequest;
        if (!XHR) return;

        var originalOpen = XHR.prototype.open;
        var originalSend = XHR.prototype.send;
        var originalSetRequestHeader = XHR.prototype.setRequestHeader;
        var originalAbort = XHR.prototype.abort;

        XHR.prototype.open = function (method, url) {
            this._wv = {
                method: (method || 'GET').toUpperCase(),
                url: url || '',
                headers: {},
                args: Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments)
            };
            return originalOpen.apply(this, arguments);
        };

        XHR.prototype.setRequestHeader = function (header, value) {
            if (this._wv) this._wv.headers[header] = value;
            return originalSetRequestHeader.call(this, header, value);
        };

        XHR.prototype.send = function (body) {
            var meta = this._wv;
            var self = this;

            if (!meta || !Utils.shouldIntercept(meta.method, body)) {
                return originalSend.call(this, body);
            }

            var requestId = Utils.genRid();
            var newUrl = Utils.appendRid(meta.url, requestId);
            self._wv_aborted = false;

            Utils.processBodyAsync(body, requestId, { source: 'xhr' }, function (normalizedBody) {
                if (self._wv_aborted) return;
                var requestData = {
                    source: 'xhr',
                    requestId: requestId,
                    method: meta.method,
                    url: meta.url,
                    query: Utils.getQueryParams(meta.url),
                    headers: Utils.cloneObject(meta.headers),
                    body: normalizedBody,
                    timestamp: Date.now()
                };
                Utils.sendToNative(requestData);
            });

            var newArgs = meta.args.slice();
            newArgs[1] = newUrl;
            delete self._wv;
            originalOpen.apply(self, newArgs);
            for (var header in meta.headers) {
                if (meta.headers.hasOwnProperty(header)) {
                    originalSetRequestHeader.call(self, header, meta.headers[header]);
                }
            }
            originalSend.call(self, body);

            self.abort = function () {
                self._wv_aborted = true;
                if (originalAbort) originalAbort.call(self);
            };
        };
    })();

    (function interceptFetch() {
        if (!window.fetch) return;

        var originalFetch = window.fetch;
        var Headers = window.Headers;
        var Request = window.Request;

        window.fetch = function (input, init) {
            init = init || {};

            var method = (init.method || 'GET').toUpperCase();
            var body = init.body;
            var url = typeof input === 'string' ? input : (input.url || '');

            if (!Utils.shouldIntercept(method, body)) {
                return originalFetch(input, init);
            }

            var requestId = Utils.genRid();
            var newUrl = Utils.appendRid(url, requestId);

            var headers = {};
            if (init.headers) {
                if (init.headers instanceof Headers) {
                    init.headers.forEach(function (value, key) { headers[key] = value; });
                } else if (typeof init.headers === 'object') {
                    headers = Utils.cloneObject(init.headers);
                }
            }

            Utils.processBodyAsync(body, requestId, { source: 'fetch' }, function (normalizedBody) {
                var requestData = {
                    source: 'fetch',
                    requestId: requestId,
                    method: method,
                    url: url,
                    query: Utils.getQueryParams(url),
                    headers: headers,
                    body: normalizedBody,
                    timestamp: Date.now()
                };
                Utils.sendToNative(requestData);
            });

            var newInput, newInit;
            if (input instanceof Request) {
                var requestInit = {
                    method: input.method,
                    headers: new Headers(headers),
                    body: body,
                    mode: input.mode,
                    credentials: input.credentials,
                    cache: input.cache,
                    redirect: input.redirect,
                    referrer: input.referrer,
                    referrerPolicy: input.referrerPolicy,
                    integrity: input.integrity
                };
                if (input.signal) requestInit.signal = input.signal;
                if (input.keepalive) requestInit.keepalive = input.keepalive;
                newInput = new Request(newUrl, requestInit);
                newInit = undefined;
            } else {
                newInit = Utils.cloneObject(init);
                newInit.headers = new Headers(headers);
                newInit.body = body;
                newInput = newUrl;
            }

            return originalFetch(newInput, newInit);
        };
    })();

You must initialize EmojiCompat prior to referencing the EmojiCompat instance.

The most likely cause of this error is disabling the EmojiCompatInitializer
either explicitly in AndroidManifest.xml, or by including
androidx.emoji2:emoji2-bundled.

Automatic initialization is typically performed by EmojiCompatInitializer. If
you are not expecting to initialize EmojiCompat manually in your application,
please check to ensure it has not been removed from your APK's manifest. You can
do this in Android Studio using Build > Analyze APK.

In the APK Analyzer, ensure that the startup entry for
EmojiCompatInitializer and InitializationProvider is present in
 AndroidManifest.xml. If it is missing or contains tools:node="remove", and you
intend to use automatic configuration, verify:

  1. Your application does not include emoji2-bundled
  2. All modules do not contain an exclusion manifest rule for
     EmojiCompatInitializer or InitializationProvider. For more information
     about manifest exclusions see the documentation for the androidx startup
     library.

If you intend to use emoji2-bundled, please call EmojiCompat.init. You can
learn more in the documentation for BundledEmojiCompatConfig.

If you intended to perform manual configuration, it is recommended that you call
EmojiCompat.init immediately on application startup.

If you still cannot resolve this issue, please open a bug with your specific
configuration to help improve error message.

attribute vec4 position;
attribute vec4 inputTextureCoordinate;

const int GAUSSIAN_SAMPLES = 9;

uniform float texelWidthOffset;
uniform float texelHeightOffset;

varying vec2 textureCoordinate;
varying vec2 blurCoordinates[GAUSSIAN_SAMPLES];

void main()
{
	gl_Position = position;
	textureCoordinate = inputTextureCoordinate.xy;
	
	// Calculate the positions for the blur
	int multiplier = 0;
	vec2 blurStep;
   vec2 singleStepOffset = vec2(texelWidthOffset, texelHeightOffset);
    
	for (int i = 0; i < GAUSSIAN_SAMPLES; i++)
   {
		multiplier = (i - ((GAUSSIAN_SAMPLES - 1) / 2));
       // Blur in x (horizontal)
       blurStep = float(multiplier) * singleStepOffset;
		blurCoordinates[i] = inputTextureCoordinate.xy + blurStep;
	}
}

{
    gl_Position = position;
    textureCoordinate = inputTextureCoordinate.xy;
}

precision
precision highp float;
varying highp vec2 textureCoordinate;

uniform sampler2D inputImageTexture;
uniform sampler2D inputImageTexture2;
uniform sampler2D inputImageTexture3;
uniform float bgWidth;
uniform float bgHeight;
uniform float vWidth;
uniform float vHeight;

float if_ge(float x, float y){return step(y, x);}
float if_lt(float x, float y){return 1.0 - if_ge(x, y);}
float if_le(float x, float y){return step(-y, -x);}
float if_gt(float x, float y){return 1.0 - if_le(x, y);}

void main()
{
   float xRatio = 1.0;
   float yRatio = 1.0;
   if(vWidth > 0.0 && vHeight > 0.0 && bgWidth > 0.0 && bgHeight > 0.0){
        float vRatio = vWidth / vHeight;
        float bgRatio = bgWidth / bgHeight;
        if(vRatio > bgRatio)
        {
            xRatio = (bgWidth * vHeight) / (bgHeight * vWidth);
        }
        else if(vRatio < bgRatio)
        {
            yRatio = (1.0 * bgHeight * vWidth) / (bgWidth * vHeight);
        }
   }
   highp vec2 anchorPoint = vec2((((textureCoordinate.x - 0.5) * 2.0) / xRatio + 1.0) / 2.0, (((textureCoordinate.y - 0.5) * 2.0) / yRatio + 1.0) / 2.0);
   lowp vec4 humanColor = texture2D(inputImageTexture, textureCoordinate);
   lowp vec4 backgroundColor = texture2D(inputImageTexture2, anchorPoint);
   lowp vec4 maskColor = texture2D(inputImageTexture3, textureCoordinate);

   float if_out_range = if_gt(if_lt(anchorPoint.x, 0.0) +
                             if_gt(anchorPoint.x, 1.0) +
                             if_lt(anchorPoint.y, 0.0) +
                             if_gt(anchorPoint.y, 1.0),
                                 0.0);
   lowp vec4 backgroundColorRet = step(0.5, if_out_range)*vec4(0.0) + step(if_out_range, 0.5)*backgroundColor;

   lowp vec4 mixColor = mix(backgroundColorRet, humanColor, maskColor.a);
   gl_FragColor = mixColor;
}

precision highp float;
varying vec2 vTextureCoord;
uniform sampler2D sTexture;
 void main() {
 vec4 color = texture2D(sTexture, vTextureCoord);
 float gray = (color.r + color.g + color.b) / 3.0;
 gl_FragColor = vec4(gray, gray, gray, color.a);
 }

precision highp float;
varying vec2 vTextureCoord;
uniform sampler2D sTexture;
uniform float width;
const vec3 COEF_Y = vec3( 0.257,  0.504,  0.114);
const vec3 COEF_U = vec3(-0.148, -0.289,  0.438);
const vec3 COEF_V = vec3( 0.438, -0.367, -0.070);
const float U_DIVIDE_LINE = 0.5;
const float V_DIVIDE_LINE = 0.75;
void main()
{
   float offsetX = 1.0 / width;
   if (vTextureCoord.y < U_DIVIDE_LINE) {
       vec2 texCoord = vec2(vTextureCoord.x, vTextureCoord.y * 2.0);
       vec4 color0 = texture2D(sTexture, vec2(texCoord.x,                 1.0 - texCoord.y));
       vec4 color1 = texture2D(sTexture, vec2(texCoord.x + offsetX,       1.0 - texCoord.y));
       vec4 color2 = texture2D(sTexture, vec2(texCoord.x + offsetX * 2.0, 1.0 - texCoord.y));
       vec4 color3 = texture2D(sTexture, vec2(texCoord.x + offsetX * 3.0, 1.0 - texCoord.y));
       float y0 = dot(color0.rgb, COEF_Y) + 16.0 / 256.0;
       float y1 = dot(color1.rgb, COEF_Y) + 16.0 / 256.0;
       float y2 = dot(color2.rgb, COEF_Y) + 16.0 / 256.0;
       float y3 = dot(color3.rgb, COEF_Y) + 16.0 / 256.0;
       gl_FragColor = vec4(y0, y1, y2, y3);
   } else if (vTextureCoord.y < V_DIVIDE_LINE) {
       if(vTextureCoord.x < 0.5) {
           vec2 texCoord = vec2(vTextureCoord.x * 2.0, (vTextureCoord.y - U_DIVIDE_LINE) * 4.0);
           vec4 color0 = texture2D(sTexture, vec2(texCoord.x,                 1.0 - texCoord.y));
           vec4 color1 = texture2D(sTexture, vec2(texCoord.x + offsetX * 2.0, 1.0 - texCoord.y));
           vec4 color2 = texture2D(sTexture, vec2(texCoord.x + offsetX * 4.0, 1.0 - texCoord.y));
           vec4 color3 = texture2D(sTexture, vec2(texCoord.x + offsetX * 6.0, 1.0 - texCoord.y));
           float u0 = dot(color0.rgb, COEF_U) + 0.5;
           float u1 = dot(color1.rgb, COEF_U) + 0.5;
           float u2 = dot(color2.rgb, COEF_U) + 0.5;
           float u3 = dot(color3.rgb, COEF_U) + 0.5;
           gl_FragColor = vec4(u0, u1, u2, u3);
       } else {
           gl_FragColor = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
       }
   } else {
       if (vTextureCoord.x < 0.5) {
           vec2 texCoord = vec2(vTextureCoord.x * 2.0, (vTextureCoord.y - V_DIVIDE_LINE) * 4.0);
           vec4 color0 = texture2D(sTexture, vec2(texCoord.x,                 1.0 - texCoord.y));
           vec4 color1 = texture2D(sTexture, vec2(texCoord.x + offsetX * 2.0, 1.0 - texCoord.y));
           vec4 color2 = texture2D(sTexture, vec2(texCoord.x + offsetX * 4.0, 1.0 - texCoord.y));
           vec4 color3 = texture2D(sTexture, vec2(texCoord.x + offsetX * 6.0, 1.0 - texCoord.y));
           float v0 = dot(color0.rgb, COEF_V) + 0.5;
           float v1 = dot(color1.rgb, COEF_V) + 0.5;
           float v2 = dot(color2.rgb, COEF_V) + 0.5;
           float v3 = dot(color3.rgb, COEF_V) + 0.5;
           gl_FragColor = vec4(v0, v1, v2, v3);
       } else {
           gl_FragColor = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
       }
   }
}
